clips.title: The story
paras: Deep beneath Orgrimmar, Grimtotem Satchel remains in Maur Grimtotem’s grasp. Troggs killed the tauren in Ragefire Chasm, but he shielded the pouch as he died. Its return to Thunder Bluff brings Magatha Grimtotem’s interest to light.

Maur Grimtotem fell to troggs deep inside Ragefire Chasm, beneath Orgrimmar. The tauren still clutched the simple leather pack when his body was found. He had fought to protect it while the troggs surrounded him. What could it hold that made him guard it with his life?
